result.summary: The page is largely well laid out, but it contains a prominent untranslated/raw localization key and several horizontally clipped items that make the feed look unfinished.

issues.description: The section heading displays the raw localization key "home_feed.popular_title" instead of a user-facing title.
issues.suggestion: Add or correct the translation for this key and render the intended localized section title, such as "Popular" or "Popular near you".

issues.description: The horizontal category row cuts off an additional chip at the right edge, and the "Fastest near you" carousel cuts off the third restaurant card and its name ("Trattoria Picco...").
issues.suggestion: Make the horizontal-scroll affordance intentional by adding adequate end padding and/or a visible fade/partial-card treatment; ensure text truncation is deliberate and does not look accidentally cropped.

issues.description: The next popular-list card is visibly cut off by the fixed bottom navigation, leaving only its upper portion visible at the bottom of the viewport.
issues.suggestion: Provide sufficient bottom content inset/padding for the scrollable feed so cards can scroll fully above the bottom navigation.
